food_pricing_v2.evidence: analyze_food_pricing.py on public sales in the trial categories, 2026-11-05: quote is the band's 75th percentile of price per list price, floor its 25th. Orders need 10, 25, 50 or 75% of shelf life, about a quarter each (2,900 orders), so under 10% left no order can use the unit: 13 of 12,040 public food sales.

buying.c_trial_note: Buyer option 3, approved 11-09: food orders in the trial arm (own order hash) also accept grade C; a C quote, or one with no grade, needs (floor + p) / (1 - p) with p = max(3 x the food-C broken rate in the ledger samples (0 of 12,131), .05). Shelf-life rule, certificate, goods and the control arm unchanged. Off unless c_trial_enabled is true and these fields are valid.

food_supply.note: Do not supply food without a supported sales-wait and use-period estimate. The only exception is the capped trial in food_trial.json.
